criteria.description: How much of the attribution guarantee rests on this being right. PREP's claim is that a passing teach-back was not accommodated by a component that saw the engineer's prior; code that widens what a component can see erodes that claim silently.

How badly a divergence here breaks a producer PREP does not control. The .load-bearing/ format is consumed from repos PREP cannot see; a mismatch surfaces as unexplained staleness rather than as an error.
What PREP is, per its maintainers: a mechanism whose verdicts mean what they claim.

members.rationale: The newest enforcement point and the only one with no prior art in the codebase; also the one a well-meaning change would most plausibly soften into a warning.

aspects.claim: an aspect id outside the supplied set is a parse failure, not a filtered-out value
nothing is salvaged from a malformed verdict; recognisable ids are not kept when others are invalid
on PASS the result is None regardless of what the judge returned

members.rationale: Duplicated by necessity in the producer skill; the two copies are pinned together by test_producer_skill.py and will drift the moment someone edits one.

aspects.claim: CRLF is normalised to LF and nothing else is: no whitespace stripping, no BOM handling
a trailing newline terminates the last line rather than beginning an empty one, so a range ending at the last line hashes the same either way
only the anchored lines are hashed, so an edit elsewhere in the file leaves the member fresh

members.rationale: The empty-scope fallback is a judgement call neither the contract nor the build order covered; it is the likeliest thing here to be changed by someone who has not read why.

aspects.claim: an aspect with an empty criteria list applies under every criterion
an aspect scoped to a component surfaces under a composite that contains it, transitively, so a composite never covers less than its parts
a region whose aspects all serve other criteria falls back to prose mode, because a structured failure must name an aspect from the set it was given
aspects are rebuilt from persisted content, so a session's scope does not change if the manifest does
